title: Mary & Pip launches financial wellness, savings, and investing app for the next generation of investors, powered by Alpaca
summary: Mary & Pip launches its US investing and wellness app, featuring managed portfolios and high-yield savings powered by Alpaca infrastructure.
body_markdown:
[Mary & Pip](https://www.maryandpip.com/?ref=alpaca.markets) , a financial wellness platform on a mission to help customers build a calmer, more intentional relationship with their money, has officially launched its app in the US. The app helps customers see their full financial picture, build better money habits, and have their investments managed by Mary & Pip Investments, LLC, an SEC-registered investment adviser, all in one place. This includes managed brokerage accounts and individual retirement accounts (IRAs), with brokerage execution, clearing, and custody services provided by Alpaca.


Founded in 2025 by[Mary Holland Nader](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mary-holland-nader-483640161/?ref=alpaca.markets) and[Kara Cooke](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kara-cooke-6844a41b4/?ref=alpaca.markets) , Mary & Pip is bringing its mission to life by making financial wellness and investing more approachable. With a focus on simplicity and building sustainable habits, the platform is designed to help customers feel more confident managing their money without adding complexity to their everyday lives.


For many people, the hardest part of investing isn't opening an account. It's figuring out what comes next. Between choosing investments, understanding risk, and finding time to manage a portfolio, getting started can feel like one more thing on an already full to-do list. Mary & Pip aims to remove some of that decision fatigue by making investing simpler and more approachable.¹


Mary & Pip aims to turn financial intent into consistent habits. Through portfolios matched to customers' risk profiles, recurring investments, and automated rebalancing, the platform helps customers build consistent investing habits without having to manage every decision themselves.²


“Every feature we build has our customers' busy lives in mind. She's a freelancer, a creative, even a corporate girl who has felt left out of the financial conversation. She's already making a hundred decisions a day just to keep her life running, and investing shouldn't be decision number 101,” said[Mary Holland Nader, Founder and CEO of Mary & Pip](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mary-holland-nader-483640161/?ref=alpaca.markets) . “That’s why we designed the platform around removing decision fatigue and building sustainable financial habits instead. We simplify it down to the essentials and let the rest run quietly in the background.”


Through[Alpaca’s Broker API](https://alpaca.markets/broker?ref=alpaca.markets) , Mary & Pip offers customers access to managed investment portfolios through eligible brokerage and IRA accounts, as well as a high-yield cash offering through Alpaca’s FDIC Bank Sweep Program. Alpaca handles the brokerage infrastructure behind the experience, including account opening, trade execution, clearing, and custody, enabling Mary & Pip to focus on building a guided investing experience for its customers.


“The products we are building around make up the foundation of financial health: a brokerage account, a retirement account, and a high yield cash account. When she signs up, it shows her which account she’s missing and finds a portfolio that matches her risk profile without the guessing. From there, recurring investments and Alpaca’s auto rebalancer do the work,” said[Kara Cooke, Co-founder, President, and Chief Investment Officer of Mary & Pip](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kara-cooke-6844a41b4/?ref=alpaca.markets) . “Alpaca gave us the infrastructure needed to build an investing experience with the automation our customers need.”


“We’re proud to support fintech innovators like Mary & Pip, who are reimagining how the next generation of investors engage with their money,” said[Yoshi Yokokawa, Co-Founder and CEO of Alpaca.](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yoshiyokokawa?ref=alpaca.markets) “By handling the complexities of brokerage infrastructure behind the scenes, we’re making it easier for ambitious founders to bring their visions to life and build innovative investing experiences that put their customers first.”
